cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, intimate atmosphere that gradually accumulates layers of tension and anticipation.
cards.palette: A grand piano provides the initial harmonic foundation with arpeggiated chords, present from the Intro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Standing alone beneath the fading light
Tracing the shadows of a heavy night
Small echoes rising from the silent ground
Waiting for the spark of life to sound
[Pre-Chorus]
The air begins to shake and sway
The colors start to bleed and gray
[Chorus]
Break the walls and touch the sky
Watch the spirit soar and fly
One heart beating in the chest of stone
Finding a kingdom to call their own
[Verse]
Mountains are calling from the distant height
Chasing the ghosts of the fading light
Every step forward is a victory won
Racing the race till the day is done
[Pre-Chorus]
The air begins to shake and sway
The colors start to bleed and gray
[Chorus]
Break the walls and touch the sky
Watch the spirit soar and fly
One heart beating in the chest of stone
Finding a kingdom to call their own
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
No more hiding in the hollow shade
Forging the path that the masters made
[Chorus]
Break the walls and touch the sky
Watch the spirit soar and fly
One heart beating in the chest of stone
Finding a kingdom to call their own
[Outro]
